question: Do restrictions of direction, time, posture, and similar factors apply in this practice?
premises: Restrictions of direction and time are considered.
Restrictions of posture and similar factors are considered.
The verse denies both kinds of restriction in this context.
inference: In this practice, there are no fixed restrictions regarding direction, time, posture, or similar matters.
plain_english: Here there is indeed no restriction of direction or time, nor any restriction of posture and so forth.
